start.text:
[TODO:tr] Spring has come. Joab leads your army.
You linger alone in the palace.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Idleness opens the door to sin.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Ride out and lead your men
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] A king belongs with his people.
[TODO:tr] Comfort dulls the heart.

rooftop_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Restless on the Roof
rooftop_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Idle eyes will find a wound.
You should have gone to war.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Yet the evening unfolds...

wine_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Set the Cup Down
wine_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] A king is not led by appetite.
Return to your duty.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You step into the cool air.

seeing.title: [TODO:tr] A Woman Bathing
seeing.text:
[TODO:tr] Below, a woman bathes in the courtyard.
Your eyes will not turn away.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Power must not take what is not yours.
[TODO:tr] Turn your eyes from temptation.
[TODO:tr] Curiosity here is the first step to ruin.

ask_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] She Is Another's Wife
ask_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She is Bathsheba, wife of Uriah.
The knowledge will not save you now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You step further into shadow.
[TODO:tr] You close your eyes and breathe.

summon_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] The Door Closes
summon_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She comes. The deed is done.
Word arrives: she is with child.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] The weight settles on your shoulders.

uriah.title: [TODO:tr] Uriah Stands Before You
uriah.text:
[TODO:tr] Uriah refuses comfort while his men sleep in fields.
"Shall I lie with my wife?"

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Order Uriah to the front to die
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Murder will not hide your sin.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Get him drunk to send him home
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Deceit breeds deeper deceit.
[TODO:tr] Truth is the only door out.

drunk_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Still He Will Not Go
drunk_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Even drunk, Uriah sleeps at your gate.
His loyalty shames you.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Send him to die in battle
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You sink deeper still.
[TODO:tr] Light is harder than the lie.

front_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Blood on Your Hands
front_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Uriah falls by the wall.
You took his wife and his life.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] The Lord sees what you have done.

nathan.title: [TODO:tr] The Prophet Comes
nathan.text:
[TODO:tr] Nathan tells of a rich man who stole a poor man's lamb.
"You are the man."

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Do not silence the voice of God.
[TODO:tr] Hiding cannot heal you.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Say: I have sinned against the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Confession opens the way.

threaten_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Hear the Word
threaten_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Nathan does not flinch.
God's voice will not be silenced.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Your knees give way.

deny_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] The Truth Cannot Hide
deny_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Your silence does not fool the Lord.
A broken spirit He will not despise.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Say: I have sinned against the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] The words break from your chest.

repentance.text:
[TODO:tr] You fall in sackcloth, weeping.
